findings.title: Sitemap Discovery
findings.evidence: Sitemap request returned status 403, expected 200. Observed: [GET sitemap.xml] status_code: 403

suggested_action.summary: Provide a valid sitemap.xml accessible at the site root.

findings.title: Page Title Presence & Quality
findings.evidence: Page is missing a <title> tag. Observed: [<head> > <title>] title: None, length: 0

suggested_action.summary: Add a descriptive <title> tag to the HTML head.

findings.title: Site Navigation Does Not Cover Core Offerings
findings.evidence:
Primary navigation does not clearly route to core service/product offerings declared in homepage headings: 1,000,000+


articles, 100,000+


articles, 10,000+


articles. Observed: [<nav> vs <h2> Offerings] uncovered_headings: ['1,000,000+\n\n\narticles', '100,000+\n\n\narticles', '10,000+\n\n\narticles'], sample_nav_links: ['donate now', 'i already donated']

suggested_action.summary: Align top-level navigation labels with key product and service offerings declared in landing headings.

findings.title: AI Bot Blocking via robots.txt
findings.evidence: robots.txt returned status 403, expected 200. Observed: [GET robots.txt] status_code: 403

suggested_action.summary: Provide a valid robots.txt accessible at the site root.

findings.title: Discoverable Internal Links
findings.evidence: No discoverable internal links were found in the HTML anchors. Observed: [<a href> tags] internal_link_count: 0, external_link_count: 379, js_nav_link_count: 4

suggested_action.summary: Expose internal site pages via standard HTML anchor links.

findings.title: Canonical URL Declaration
findings.evidence: No canonical URL link tag (<link rel='canonical'>) was declared. Observed: [<head> > <link rel='canonical'>] canonical_url: None, target_url: https://www.wikipedia.org/

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referential canonical URL tag.
